testCase:
G-026: Same label: Email in two forms
Goal: Send an enquiry from Wilhelmina Tarrow (w.tarrow@example.org) asking whether she can bring a tandem on the first crossing.
STEP 1: Navigate to /gopro/patterns/p26.html
STEP 2: Enter "Wilhelmina Tarrow" in the name field
STEP 3: Enter "w.tarrow@example.org" in the email field in the enquiry form
STEP 4: Enter "Can I bring a tandem on the first crossing?" in the message field
STEP 5: Click the "Send enquiry" button
STEP 6: Verify that 'the reply goes to w.tarrow@example.org' is visible
STEP 7: Enter "w.tarrow@example.org" in the email field

steps.note: Target the enquiry form rather than the other Email field.

args.label: Message
args.value: Can I bring a tandem on the first crossing?

steps.note: Verify the reply goes to the supplied enquiry email address.

reasoning: This tests sending Wilhelmina Tarrow's enquiry using the Email field in the enquiry form and verifying the reply address. The final unscoped Email entry is omitted because two forms share that label, leaving its target ambiguous.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Step 7 does not specify which of the two forms' Email fields to fill.
gaps: Step 7 does not specify which of the two forms' Email fields to fill.
